opening.argument: The speaker presents Beluga as a crypto discovery and information platform at a Litecoin Summit presentation. Its stated aim is “to be a platform where we reveal and find the best products in crypto,” supported by reviews of newly launching products and a slide describing its mission to showcase crypto projects. References to buying Bitcoin for potential profit and to new tokens or projects serve the discussion of industry adoption and product strategy; they are not a guaranteed-return solicitation. Nothing in the described material requires payment, requests credentials, claims a false affiliation, promises a deceptive outcome, or solicits a specific transaction.
